# clsx source record

React Aria Components brings `clsx@2.1.1` into the production bundle from
[`lukeed/clsx`](https://github.com/lukeed/clsx/tree/v2.1.1). It is locked by npm
archive integrity metadata in `package-lock.json` and is licensed under the
